dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, continuous geometric narrowing from the mid-lateral maxima toward the posterior peduncle region.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Asymmetrical lateral margins; the left margin exhibits a pronounced convex curvature, while the right margin appears more linear without distinct pathological indentations.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light blue-grey; median intensity suggests a sub-adult or light-colored juvenile phase.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low density; diffuse, low-contrast darker shading visible along the lower left quadrant and posterior surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Sharp, high-contrast interface between the depigmented epidermis and the dark ambient water environment.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Multiple fine, vertically oriented linear white marks (likely rake marks) present on the right posterior dorsal surface.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Significant sagittal shadow indicating a prominent, non-deformed dorsal ridge along the central axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A series of at least three distinct, parallel vertical linear scars on the right side of the dorsal ridge.
other_distinctive_markers: Aperture of the blowhole is visible as a high-contrast, dark elliptical feature at the anterior-most point of the exposed dorsal area.
